Manipur Security Operations Lead to Arrests Amidst Transporter Complaints

Security forces in Manipur have conducted operations resulting in the arrest of seven individuals found with arms. Additionally, fuel transporters have reported instances of 'highway extortion'. The events highlight ongoing security challenges and economic disruptions in the region.
